name: Stableside
summary: Stableside is a family-focused lifestyle center in Katy, Texas featuring carefully curated restaurants, stores, and local businesses in a welcoming open-air environment. The center distinguishes itself with unique amenities like Mural Alley and regular community events that create a safe, fun gathering place for the whole family.
demographics: Stableside attracts primarily affluent families and young professionals from the Katy, Texas area, with household incomes typically exceeding $100,000 annually. The trade area serves the rapidly growing western Houston suburbs, drawing visitors who value curated shopping experiences and family-friendly environments. Typical shoppers are homeowners aged 30-55 with children, seeking convenient access to quality restaurants, local services, and specialty retail in a safe, walkable setting.
description: Stableside is a carefully curated lifestyle center in Katy, Texas that serves as a gathering place inspired by the families that surround it. Located at 9806 Gaston Road, this open-air shopping destination brings together a thoughtfully selected collection of restaurants, stores, and local businesses to create a welcoming, safe, and fun environment the whole family can enjoy. The center features a unique Mural Alley, created by Pandr Design Co. artists Phoebe and Roxy, who painted twelve vibrant murals in just five days, adding an artistic and Instagram-worthy dimension to the shopping experience. Stableside positions itself as more than just a shopping center—it's a community hub where local businesses thrive and families can spend quality time together. With its focus on creating an inviting atmosphere and hosting regular events, Stableside has become a beloved destination in the Katy community, earning a 4-star rating from visitors who appreciate its family-oriented approach and carefully selected tenant mix.
